name: Claude
description: Claude in the AI Chat. With Claude Code (your Claude plan) it reads the folder, keeps a session per chat and proposes edits you review as a diff (with the MCP Server mod). Or with the Claude API and an API key kept in your Keychain — no CLI needed.
author: AICode

mode.description: cli: Claude Code, signed in with your Claude plan. api: the Claude API with your API key (set the key with the Configure command, or the chat's agent picker).
